notes: Feeds W8-19f (dialogs::settings::pages::files). Reflection over the internal FilesSettingsPage and SettingsPageBuilder of PhotoReview.dll; see tools/oracle-cs/Commands/W8-19f.cs for the case kinds and output fields.

id_base is SettingsDialog.PageIdBase(5) = 6000 (Files is the sixth navigation entry). English default localizer. Run against the C# baseline d92d6aae (the HEAD page has the external editors controls).
initial_folder: make=none uses the given path; temp_file / temp_dir make a temporary folder that the oracle deletes. The result is reported as result_kind (null | parent_dir | other).

cases.name: initial folder of an empty path
initial folder of a blank path
initial folder of a missing file
initial folder of a path with invalid characters
initial folder of an existing file is its folder
initial folder of an existing directory is null
